entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET 10 Blazor WASM hang #122529
  • .NET 10 runtime internal error with exit code 0x80131506. #122528
  • Build fails on "packs" #122524
  • HttpMetricsTest_Http20.TimeInQueue_RecordedForNewConnectionsOnly test failure #122522
  • Buffered FileStream incorrectly reads past end of FileStream, causing IOException on raw disk device streams. #122521
  • System.Threading.Threads.Tests.ThreadTests.IsBackgroundTest test failure #122520
  • [Mono] UnmanagedCallersOnly returns false but native receives true when using byte return type in iOS ARM64 #122519
  • Array.ConstrainedCopy doesn't enjoy quick path treatment as Array.Copy #122518

Closed

  • Consider bumping minimum iOS / tvOS version to 13 #120457
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix build failure on "Packs" #122527
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Enable runtime async for native AOT testing #122526
    NO-MERGE, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Use TaskHostFactory to resolve file lock issues and simplify tasks build #122525
    area-Infrastructure
  • [RuntimeAsync] Remove reflection TODOs. Add tests. #122517
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async, 11.0.0

Merged

  • Fix dataflow analysis of lambdas in async methods #122450
    linkable-framework, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Fix scenarios involving GVM on reflection-blocked methods #122497
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Don't runtime-await Delegate.Invoke methods #122491
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Bump minimum iOS/tvOS version from 12.2 to 13.0 and MacCatalyst from 15.0 to 15.2 #122436
  • Rework bootstrap layout usage for AOT publish of cdac project #122471
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr
  • [Wasm RyuJit] Fixes for some issues in codegen bringup tests #122483
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Update build script to append `.slnx` for some uses of the `-vs` flag #122312
    needs-area-label

Updated

  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
    area-Debugger-mono, community-contribution
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Add Instruction Encoding for Local Var Declarations and Emit Local Declarations #122425
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Add AddRef to callee that caches interface ptr #122509
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices
  • [RISC-V] Enable constant CSE in RISCV64 #121739
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
  • Add wasm as SPMI target #122510
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [RISC-V] Introduce Zbs #115335
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv, 11.0.0
  • Enable ARM (32-bit) deb/rpm package generation #122349
    area-Infrastructure-installer, community-contribution
  • Allow emitting line number information into native AOT apps #122227
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • remove RuntimeAsyncTaskCore #122505
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Reduce the number of sections in R2R PE files #122511
    tenet-performance, area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Redo fix lookup for current Thread in async signal handler #122513
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Switch Apple's digest functionality to CryptoKit #120953
    area-System.Security, cryptographic-docs-impact
  • Split NativeAOT tests to use separate merged runners #120949
    area-Infrastructure, os-ios
  • [RISC-V] Fix 64-bit offset handling in `emitLoadImmediate` #122501
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • [WIP] Create MethodGenericDictionary for calls to GVMs #122012
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122477
    NO-MERGE, area-codeflow
  • [RuntimeAsync] Enable runtime async in Libraries partition #119432
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, runtime-async
  • Insert a set of known types and methods references necessary for async thunks into the mutable module #121679
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [release/8.0-staging] Use explicit versions for MSBuild properties #122502
    Servicing-approved, area-Infrastructure
  • Add test coverage for Task/ValueTask-returning methods with __arglist #122500
